channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye, Iran agree Israeli expansionism biggest threat to region
item.description: The Turkish and Iranian top diplomats have agreed that the continued Israeli expansionism through attacks against Gaza, Syria and Lebanon constitutes the biggest threat to the stability and peace in the region.

item.title: ‘Gypsy Girl’ motif breathes new life into traditional quilt-making
item.description: In the southern province of Kilis, the centuries-old art of quilt-making — a local tradition once on the verge of extinction — is experiencing a vibrant revival through a project that fuses classic techniques with contemporary designs featuring the iconic “Gypsy Girl” motif.

item.title: Türkiye’s cultural spending soars 83 pct in 2024: Official data
item.description: Türkiye’s cultural expenditures rose sharply in 2024, increasing 83 percent from the previous year to 408 billion Turkish Liras (around $9.1 billion), according to official data released by the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) on Dec. 1.

item.title: Turkish Cyprus, Antalya set to anchor Türkiye’s New Year holiday period
item.description: Turkish Cyprus and Antalya hotels have emerged as top picks for year-end celebrations, with most hotels now bundling the midweek New Year’s Eve with the Jan. 1 holiday and weekend into attractive three- and four-night celebration packages.

item.title: Russia’s Gazprom holds talks with Türkiye to extend gas supply deal
item.description: Russia’s Gazprom is in discussions with Turkish partners to potentially extend existing gas contracts, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak told Russian state-run TASS on Dec. 1.

item.title: Local content in defense industry reaches 82 pct: VP Yılmaz
item.description: Türkiye’s defense sector has reached an 82 percent local content rate, improving from a position of being nearly 80 percent dependent on foreign sources two decades ago, Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz told parliament’s budget committee on Dec. 1.

item.title: 103 terror members surrender through persuasion, says Yerlikaya
item.description: Türkiye’s security forces have maintained uninterrupted counterterrorism operations throughout the year, reporting significant seizures, destroyed hideouts and a rise in militants surrendering through persuasion efforts, Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya said on Dec. 1.

item.title: Race to get aid to Asia flood survivors as toll nears 1,200
item.description: Governments and aid groups in Indonesia and Sri Lanka worked to rush aid Tuesday to hundreds of thousands stranded by deadly flooding that has killed around 1,200 people in four countries.

item.title: Kızılelma success reflects Türkiye’s dynamism: Erdoğan
item.description: Türkiye's Kızılelma, an unmanned fighter jet, scored a world-first in aviation history this weekend, the president said on Monday, arguing that the country is experiencing "this dynamism" across all fields.

item.title: US envoy to meet Russia's Putin for talks on ending Ukraine war
item.description: U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and Russian President Vladimir Putin are expected to hold talks in Moscow on Tuesday to discuss the Trump administration's controversial proposal to end the war in Ukraine.
